newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen lists 32 A shares, one B stock in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen lists 32 A shares, one B stock in Q1.

text.p: The Shenzhen Stock Exchange received 32 domestic currency A share and one foreign currency B share listings in the first quarter of 1997, an exchange official said on Friday.
The exchange listed seven A stocks but no B shares in the same period in 1996, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Companies issued about 1.1 billion A shares in the first quarter of 1997 and raised about 7.3 billion yuan, the official said.
Of the 32 A stocks listed in this period, 12 were based in the less developed central and western provinces, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Friday.

Wafangdian Bearing Co, the only company to list foreign currency B shares in the first three months of 1997, made its debut on the south China bourse with a flotation of 130 million B shares on March 25.
By March 31, a total of 259 A share companies had listed in Shenzhen, the Securities Times said. There are 44 Shenzhen-listed B share firms.
In the whole of 1996, Shenzhen listed 109 counters, which raised about 13 billion yuan for the companies, the official said.
Of the 1996 new listings, 100 were A shares raising 9.87 billion yuan and the remaining nine B share listings raised HK$2.79 billion, he said.
